newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint recoups losses vs dlr towards close.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint recoups losses vs dlr towards close.

text.p: The Hungarian forint regained most of the ground it lost against the dollar in speculative morning trade, dealers said on Wednesday.
"The day's movements were dominated by the dollar/mark cross, with currency buying in the morning and profit-taking in the afternoon," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
The forint closed at 153.30/35 to the dollar, only some five pips weaker than the central bank bid. That compares with a morning low of 153.75/80 and a 30 pips gap from the bid earlier.
German mark deals dominated forex trade, but turnover was seen only average despite lively trade, he added.
